title: Phase 84 adds food-systems, local-provisioning, and community-resource-security controls
summary: Eight inactive production and sovereignty dossiers, eight inactive processing and provisioning ledgers, eight inactive access and nutrition registers, and eight inactive reserve and resource-security ledgers now expose the complete food-security contract. Twelve guides and six maps deepen the content without allocating, procuring, releasing, rationing, recalling, scoring, ranking, or deciding for a community.
evidence_note: This release contains empty production, land, water, sovereignty, processing, storage, logistics, procurement, workforce, access, affordability, nutrition, institutional-meal, reserve, contamination, circularity, and resource-security contracts plus synthetic-only validation. It contains no verified Phase 83 collective-resilience record or Phase 84 decision or receipt.
publication_effect: Adds twelve Published briefings, six Published maps, one searchable registry with thirty-two detail routes, one public export, and reader-surface integrations while leaving all evidence, community, food-system, household, emergency, and operating states unchanged.
